short: Quantum-Dot Sensitized Solar Cells Employing Hierarchical Cu
title: Quantum-Dot Sensitized Solar Cells Employing Hierarchical Cu2S Microspheres Wrapped by Reduced Graphene Oxide Nanosheets as Effective Counter Electrodes

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: QDSSCs need a cheap counter electrode that reduces polysulfide fast; Pt is expensive and is poisoned by the polysulfide electrolyte. Wrapping hierarchical Cu2S microspheres in reduced graphene oxide should add conductive paths and accessible catalytic sites and so raise the cell efficiency.
states.detail: Absorbed: b1 (HYP/need), b2 (HYP/hypothesis), b3 (DES/base_system), b4 (DES/modification), b5 (DES/variable_sweep), b6 (PRC/synthesis), b7 (PRC/treatment). Premises: Pt counter electrodes are poisoned in polysulfide electrolyte, and Cu2S is the standard alternative for QDSSCs

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Hierarchical microspheres built from nanoflakes; with GO the flakes become much finer and more numerous, giving a flower-like sphere. RGO nanosheets partially and irregularly wrap the microspheres; coverage grows with GO until at 20 mL the spheres are buried in crumpled sheets.

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: The composite electrode is a far better polysulfide-reduction catalyst than Pt: about 100x the reduction peak current and the highest exchange current density. Charge-transfer resistance at the electrode/electrolyte interface falls to about 3.4 ohm for RGO-Cu2S-2, roughly half that of Cu2S and far below Pt.
states.detail: Absorbed: b12 (PRP/value), b13 (PRP/value), b14 (MEC/pathway), b16 (MEC/tradeoff). Premises: For a QDSSC counter electrode the cathodic peak current of the voltammogram is the measure of catalytic ability for Sx2- reduction

states.title: Performance state
states.head: A CdS/CdSe QDSSC with the RGO-Cu2S-2 counter electrode reaches 3.85% efficiency (Voc 0.556 V, Jsc 15.85 mA/cm2, FF 0.44) under AM 1.5G

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: One-step solvothermal RGO wrapping turns hierarchical Cu2S microspheres into a Pt-free counter electrode that outperforms both Pt and bare Cu2S

nodes.title: XRD, F3
nodes.head: The Cu2S reflection intensities fall and the background rises progressively from Cu2S through RGO-Cu2S-1 and -2 to RGO-Cu2S-3
nodes.solves: RGO nanosheets partially and irregularly wrap the microspheres; coverage grows with GO until at 20 mL the spheres are buried in crumpled sheets
nodes.note: the traces are offset, so the comparison is of peak-to-background contrast, not of absolute counts
nodes.necessity_reason: S1 keeps shown support from q1, q2, q4, q11 after removal.

nodes.title: DERIVED, F3
nodes.head: The RGO-Cu2S-2 isotherm lies above the Cu2S one at every relative pressure, both with a hysteresis loop that opens only above P/P0 about 0.8
nodes.solves: The RGO composite is more porous: higher adsorbed volume at every relative pressure and a mesoporous, interparticle pore network (20.11 vs 14.59 m2/g)
nodes.note: the inset pore-size distributions of both samples peak near 20 nm, so the tabulated average pore sizes of 6.61 and 11.33 nm cannot be read off this panel
nodes.detail: q10: The RGO-Cu2S-2 isotherm lies above the Cu2S one at every relative pressure, both with a hysteresis loop that opens only above P/P0 about 0.8
nodes.necessity_reason: No member reaches image_support shown, and S1 keeps shown support from q1, q2, q4, q9.

nodes.title: IR, RAMAN, F3
nodes.head: The GO bands at 3411, 1726, 1628, 1171, 1068 and 886 cm-1 are gone from the RGO-Cu2S spectrum, which is nearly featureless like Cu2S. The G band moves from 1604 cm-1 in GO to 1583 cm-1 in RGO-Cu2S, and second-order bands at 2705, 2971 and 3136 cm-1 appear
nodes.solves: GO is reduced during the solvothermal step: the oxygen-containing groups are removed and a graphitic RGO network remains
nodes.note: band positions are the labels printed on the panel; the D band stays at 1335 cm-1 in both
nodes.detail: q11: The GO bands at 3411, 1726, 1628, 1171, 1068 and 886 cm-1 are gone from the RGO-Cu2S spectrum, which is nearly featureless like Cu2S; q12: The G band moves from 1604 cm-1 in GO to 1583 cm-1 in RGO-Cu2S, and second-order bands at 2705, 2971 and 3136 cm-1 appear
nodes.necessity_reason: S1 keeps shown support from q1, q2, q4, q9 after removal.

nodes.title: ECHEM, UVVIS:IPCE, F5
nodes.head: J-V curves rank the three cells throughout: Jsc about 13.0, 15.0 and 15.8 mA/cm2 and Voc about 0.525, 0.545 and 0.556 V for Pt, Cu2S and RGO-Cu2S. IPCE of the RGO-Cu2S cell is highest across 330-620 nm, peaking near 95% at 345 nm against about 87% for Cu2S and 65% for Pt; all share a 640 nm onset
nodes.solves: A CdS/CdSe QDSSC with the RGO-Cu2S-2 counter electrode reaches 3.85% efficiency (Voc 0.556 V, Jsc 15.85 mA/cm2, FF 0.44) under AM 1.5G
